name: target-cursor
title: Target Cursor
description: A small crosshair follows the cursor; over anything clickable it snaps out into corner brackets that frame the target.

meta.reducedMotion: Brackets jump to targets without easing.
meta.useWhen: Precision tools, cameras, games, architecture and engineering concepts.
meta.avoidWhen: Content sites; together with another cursor effect; when it would hide the system cursor (it doesn't by default).
